method: Read614 additional lines, closing all source gaps through main.rs6130. Static SQLite persistence and follow-up concurrency analysis.
findings: start_follow_up_chat has no ai_pending rejection or per-chat worker lock; start_ai_activity sets pending then spawns independent worker. Combined with previously read keyboard Enter path and chat-id-only receiver, overlapping same-chat requests are source-reachable; no Windows timing reproduction.

Each worker reads current history then writes Executing and later success using its captured original_prompt/response, without transaction/version predicate. Overlapping workers can overwrite one another rather than append both turns. Failure only publishes UI error, leaving stored Executing placeholder in reviewed path.

store_ai_chat ignores INSERT result then returns Some(last_insert_rowid()). Failed insert may yield0 or prior connection insert id instead of None; this can corrupt active chat identity/error reporting. No failed-insert runtime fixture in this batch.

Agent memory insert uniqueness is case-sensitive agent_name/content, while context retrieval uses lower(agent_name)=lower(?). Case variants can combine contexts; no agent-id association, per-content budget or edit/delete reconciliation here.
ensure_default_agents deletes every agent named hermes case-insensitively on startup, not only a seeded-default row marker. This is source behavior; no actual user agent data changed.

compute_result_reasons does filesystem metadata lookups for every unique launch command in received results on UI path. Comment claims at most30, while caller MAX_RESULTS300 and engine broad candidate expansion can return more. No latency measurement; no optimization accepted.
plugin_execution_allowed checks calculator/snippet/color-picker/circle-search flags and otherwise returns true. This is a feature gate, not general authorization. No command/source strings executed.
Clipboard selection helper parses numeric suffix without enforcing clip prefix and aliases selections by timestamp, consistent with earlier collision reproduction. No new SQL runtime controls.
Forms persistence is still outside this read range; no save reliability claim from navigation into form alone.
limits: No new tests or local production edits; SQL/follow-up findings source-level only.
